title: Pills and toasts say what happened, never how to do something
goal: The little pills and notices over the canvas report results (Saved, Copied, 3 layers separated) and never instructions. Today holding the Pen, Measure or a path point puts a standing sentence of how-to at the foot of the canvas, and several result notices end with a line of advice; the teaching moves to the tool's hover tip and the tutorials, the way a professional Mac editor does it.
notes: From the IA contract task. Contract row: 'Toasts: what just happened. Results, with Undo when it applies. Never instructions.' and Canvas: 'never persistent status pills'. Inventory (2026-09-29): standing hints EditorView.swift:437 (Measure), :439 (path edit), :456 (Pen); copy in PhotonzCore/MeasureToolMode.swift:76-79, PenDrawing.swift:574-602, PathEditHint.swift:23-133; result+advice in RegionSliceRefusal.swift:134, TextReading.swift:318, CopyConfirmation.swift:410,417,474,477-480,534; empty-state text EditorView.swift:2468 ('Pick a clip to trim'), InspectorPanel.swift:418 ('Pick a clip on the timeline'). A refusal that needs a choice is an alert, not a toast. ChromeCopyBudgetTests is the existing guard; extend it to hold the no-instructions rule.
acceptance: Picking up the Pen, Measure (any mode) or editing a path puts no sentence of instructions over the canvas; what it said is in that tool's hover tip or its tutorial, in the same words
No notice ends with advice (try again, run it again, switch Fill on, from the Layer menu, Command Z); where the result needs a way out, the notice carries a button (Undo, Show) instead
Empty states say nothing or one short label: no 'Pick a clip to trim' over the canvas and no 'Pick a clip on the timeline' in the panel
Where a mock page prints one of these lines, it is not dropped quietly: it moves behind the tool's tip per UX-PATTERNS section 4 and the audit's rough names it, or a decision card asks
A walk at Next defaults photographs the Pen, Measure and a path edit with no instruction pill, and an audit is written under queue/audits/

log.note: Epic design-system is staged next, not now; doing it anyway because it is a p1 carried straight out of the user's IA contract (2026-09-29) that the last three commits have been building. Plan: new Next flag next-notices-say-what-happened (on by default in Next, off in Current so Current keeps every line). With it on: no Measure mode pill, no Pen pill, no path-points pill; their words go into a second line of the tool's hover tip (Pen, Measure per mode) and the reshape tutorial (path gestures); the path results (Turned into a path, Joined, Closed, Nothing joined, Nothing closed) become ordinary result notices, the first three with an Undo button; a Pen click on the first point of a flat path raises Nothing closed after the click instead of a warning before it; every notice line loses its trailing advice; the trim capsule and the panel say nothing with no clip picked.

Adversarial review before building: (1) a first-time Pen user loses the only on-screen line that tells Return from Esc, and Esc discards a drawing: mitigated by the tip saying it, the Draw it with the Pen tutorial, and Photoshop/Pixelmator both teach this in rich tips with nothing on the canvas. (2) Measure's I key cycles modes and the pill was how you saw the mode you landed on; the tool button's glyph and the tool options capsule's Mode control still show it, so nothing is lost but a two second echo. (3) The mocks print canvas hints: redline.html 'Measure mode: click two points for a live distance', draw.html / vector-wt.html 'Drag an anchor or a handle ...' and 'Click on the artboard to place an anchor'. The user's later contract (canvas: never persistent status pills; toasts: never instructions) wins per UX-PATTERNS 4; they move to the tip and the audit's rough names each. (4) A refused Pen close used to be explained before the click; now it is reported after it, which is what Photoshop does (it says nothing at all).

owns these walks: notices-say-what-happened-walk, close-an-open-path-walk, join-two-pen-paths-walk, path-points-under-the-pen-walk, pen-hands-back-walk, turn-into-a-path-walk, tutorial-draw-it-with-the-pen-walk, tutorial-reshape-what-you-drew-walk

Built behind next-notices-say-what-happened (Next only, on by default; area canvas). Core: NoticeCopy.instructions(in:) is the no-advice test; CopyConfirmation.resultsOnly picks the result line (RegionSliceRefusal.result, TextReading.Refusal.result, LookPaste.result, PathCombinePlan.result, ComponentPieceRefusal.result, separated 'run it again' dropped); new subjects pathTurned/pathJoined/pathClosed/nothingJoined/nothingClosed and CanvasNoticeAction.undo (only undoes while the document is still the one the pill reported; any new edit takes the pill down); RecordingDoor.gaveUpMessage(resultsOnly:). App: showsPenHint/showsPathEditHint false and showMeasureModeHint a no-op with the flag; path commands go through sayWhatHappenedToPaths; the Pen's refused close calls onPenCloseRefused -> Nothing closed notice; HintTooltipView grew an optional detail line (220pt wide) fed by PenSession.toolTipDetail and MeasureToolMode.toolTipDetail; trim capsule and panel empty state say nothing. Tests: NoticesSayWhatHappenedTests, ChromeNeverSaysHowTests (every chrome string of 3+ words that opens on an instruction, shrink-only allowance). expectHint 'none' claims no chip. Full suite green (10,619), 27 walks green including the new notices-say-what-happened-walk at Next defaults with 9 real captures; the Undo button is pressed on its face by the pointer.

Left rough (not filed): Trim/panel empty states with no clip are not photographed by any walk (need a recording in the editor); VideoCropOverlay's 'Drag to crop' pill stays, allow-listed, because it lives in the retired recording window Next does not open; the ComponentPieceRefusal notice has no Detach button (Detach is on the copy's menus). Mock lines moved to tips are named in the audit's rough.

Next (next-notices-say-what-happened, on by default): no how-to pill for the Pen, Measure or a path; their words are the tool tips' second line and two tutorial cards; path commands report as notices with a clickable Undo; every notice drops its trailing advice; trim and panel empty states say nothing. Verified: full suite green (10,619 tests), 27 walks green including notices-say-what-happened-walk at Next defaults with 9 real captures, audit queue/audits/2026-09-30-notices-say-what-happened.json.
